sections.appearance: Toki is a petite teenage girl with blond hair in a bun hairstyle with some navy blue lines in the sides over a white maid ribbon with a aquamarine lace, blue eyes with heavy eyelashes decorated in a dark purple eyeliner, and pale skin. Halo ==== Her halo has five black outer segments with blue rims and a blue small circle inside of them. Uniform ==== Toki's Mode 1 uniform is a regular maid uniform. Paired to her uniform is a white apron, a small blue ribbon, a black dress with white trim and a detachable lower long skirt, a large blue ribbon at her back, an other shorter overskirt, black fingerless elbow gloves with white rings, black web gear with blue parts, and long white high-heeled shoes with black heels and a blue circle on each shoe. When accessing Mode 2, Toki's uniform's long sleeves and the lower long skirt off are gone, revealing her codename 04 on the left elbow glove. Her gloves and high heels are made of an unknown white-colored armor, protecting her limbs up to her knees and elbows. Before wearing Abi-Eshuh, Toki will take her Mode 2 uniform off, revealing that she wears a delft blue and black leotard and a black leg band with a buckle on the left thigh. sections.personality: Compared to the rest of C&C, Toki always shows a serious and emotionless expression, which is to be expected from Rio's bodyguard. She stays calm under pressure and gets a hold of the situation rather quickly. {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="border: 2px solid #4F86F7; text-align:left; width: 100%; moz-border-radius:5px;-webkit-border-radius:5px;" ! style="background: #4F86F7; border: 1px solid #000000; color: #4F86F7; text-align:center; moz-border-radius:5px;-webkit-border-radius:5px;" | |- | style="padding: 1%;" | According to Himari, a big part as to why Toki ended up being emotionless was because Rio isolated her from socializing with anyone. When Rio disappeared from Millennium after the events of Volume 2, Toki temporarily joined C&C but quickly excused herself. Himari spited Rio and told her the reason for Toki's leave was because she could not fit in and live normally without the one person that she could understand.
